review_description: I have waited a few months to write this review to see how the system performed. It’s fantastic. Central Coast Energy have been both friendly and professional from getting a quote, to installation, to after sales service. The system is exactly as they said it would be and I have felt well supported all the way through. Great local team, I highly recommend them

Leigh, I am writing to thank you for the quality of service provided by you this morning. We sincerely appreciate your efficient, gracious customer service, the level of detail and accountability..... We are happy for choosing your company for our solar panels.

From the initial consultation to the final panel placement, and all the questions in between, Leigh displayed patience, professionalism and expertise. Not only did he design a system tailored to my energy needs, but they also guided me through the incentives and rebates, making the process hassle-free.The all-black panels are sleek and seamlessly integrated into my home's aesthetic. I couldn't be happier with my decision to trust Central Coast Energy for a brighter, cleaner, and more sustainable future.

Leigh and the team were great. They showed up when they said they would, did an excellent job (in a location with difficult access), were very tidy and professional. My solar system is performing unreal - panels, inverter and battery system. I couldn’t be happier!
We had our solar system installed by Leigh and his team and was very happy with the service from start to finish highly recommend.

Leigh McInerney from Central Coast Energy has been an absolute pleasure to deal with on my Installation of Solar in Forresters beach. It took me two years to decide to do it and Leigh was always happy to answer my questions and provide advice along the way. The installation went well and Leighs processes makes the installation stress free for the owner. Great Job and Exceptional customer service!
CC solar are great, pre install, install and after sales support all great.
We were happy with the entire process, from quote to installation, the team were polite, knowledgeable and completed in a professional manner.

The sales and quoting process was thorough and Phil was able to pay me a visit and provide a great breakdown of everything. The installation team were diligent in their work and really took the time to make sure they got it right. Everything about this process was simple, transparent and stress-free. Highly recommended!

Central Coast Energy recently installed solar panels after we had researched a number of suppliers.  We found the process, from the initial quote, to installation and follow-up to have been thoroughly professional and impressively hassle-free.  The actual installation was carried out on the day promised, neatly and with a minimum of fuss.  Leigh’s follow-up in helping me change the settings when I installed a new modem was very helpful and valued.  Congratulations and thank you to the great team at Central Coast Energy.

The installers went above and beyond. Even fixed up issues that our roofing repair contractor missed! Professional service with a can do attitude. Discussed options clearly from start to finish. Couldn’t expect more!
From the quoting process all the way through to completion has been nothing but absolute quality. Very happy with the final results. Thanks Alex

These guys did a great job. Delivered in the time they quoted with a great price. System is working awesome and is easy to track with the app. Will be looking to these guys for any further installations (batteries etc)

From the quote to the installation process, everything was seamless.Polite, professional and extremely helpful.Options for systems were given, the price was excellent, the service even better.This was so easy, not sure why we waited so long!

All communication with CC Energy was professional and all staff involved in quote and installation respectful and easy to work with.Installer was on time and worked efficiently. He communicated with us about the installation and worked quickly to get the job done on time.They contacted us after the installation to see how things were going and told us we needed to update some electrical work before the smart meter could be installed.We have been very happy with the outcome so far and would highly recommend them.

Really delighted to be able to deal with a local business who took the time to actually visit our location and advise and recommend a complete system that performs as described and no hidden extra charges.The installation team was extremely professional and completed the job to our total satisfaction.
Sales & Quoting was very professional.Installation went without a hitch and connection to the grid was organised by them

Helpful in quoting process, made suggested layout changes with prompt response and answered questions.Install was as scheduled and completed on the day, no fuss, neat workmanship, confirmed layout of panels and location of inverter.Local Central Coast supplier using subcontracted installers, however the co-ordination is obviously good.Would recommend.
Professionally Installed in a no fuss manner and on time. Thank you so much Central Coast Energy

Excellent to deal with, Phil explained and provided all options and competitive quote and followed through to work through the contract process, Leigh co-ordinated all the install and the contractors were prompt, polite & tidied up after works were complete. These guys know there stuff and do a quality job would recommend them to install your system on the Central Coast.

CENTRAL COAST ENERGY ARE HIGHLY RECOMMENDED, Great customer service from start to finish, they did exactly what they agreed to do, turned up exactly on time even though the weather was awful on the day of installation the team still carried on with the job with no complaints.Leigh, Phil and the team were brilliant from the day of the initial quote/survey right through to completing the job, its always nice to support local business and with a company like Central Coast Energy its a very easy decision to make.We are very very pleased with not only our decision to go solar but to choose Central Coast Energy as our installer.

The team from Central Coast Energy were excellent.  From the quoting by Phil, installing with Jay and the boys, and Leigh with organising, we are extremely happy with their work, communication and finished product.  Would highly recommend this business.

10kW panels east/west, 8kW inverterThe quoting process was good. Lots of information and options, not pushy, good knowledge of solar systems. The quote documents were detailed and explained what was included.The price is good value for a long term solar installation company that looks to be around for years to come - important when looking at warranties. The install was done on the install date, good group of installers to get everything in, wiring all clean and professional. Everything done on the day - nothing that needed to be fixed later. Good information for the smart meter change over and post install information about using the inverter. I'm confident that if there are any questions, they'll be happy to help and able to resolve any issues.

Highly recommend Central Coast Energy. Such great customer service. They will not try and oversell the products to you, which we found to be a big issue with other companies. It has been great to be able to support a local business. Leigh, Phil and team were fantastic from start to finish and we are very happy customers.

I contacted Central Coast Energy as I already had several quotes from well known companies who sell solar but sub-contract out the installation. I wanted one company to provide and install my equipment.Leigh was extremely knowledgeable and helpful, we settled on our plan and the install day arrived. The installation team were very pleasant and happy to explain how the equipment operated.There was no mess and no unexpected breakages to terracotta roof tiles.After consideration of all the options I chose a 9.7kw system with QCells solar panels and a 25 year warranty for peace of mind, with a Fronius inverter. So far so good, we are very happy with the choices we have made.Thanks Central Coast Energy - we are definitely recommending you to our friends!

The sales person was extremely knowledgable about all the options available in installing solar panels and was able to explain everything clearly. He was also personable and friendly and happy to answer any questions, in spite of having got up that morning to find that his car had been broken into and his laptop and all his papers had been stolen. They were the best value for money compared to other companies and the wait time for installation was only 3 weeks. The installation went smoothly and was carried out by very friendly and pleasant staff. Highly recommended.

Fantastic service from the beginning. Quote was done within 48hrs, excellent price for system requested and was kept in contact with throughout the process. Installation was fast and professional. All team members from quote to office and installation were easy to get along with and could not be happier. Would absolutely recommend Leigh and the team at Central Coast Energy.

My wife and I would not hesitate to recommend Central Coast Energy.  From start to finish the customer service and installation was five star.  They are punctual, polite and very tidy.  Leigh and Phil explained everything even arranging for our meter to be replaced.  We are 100% happy with our choose and have already recommended them to our family, friends and business acquaintances.RegardsBarry Targett

After extensive research we decided to support a local supplier in Central Coast Energy. From the initial consultation with Dylan, through the installation with Jay and follow up from Leigh our expectations have been truly met and surpassed. We would highly recommend Leigh and the team at Central Coast Energy.

I had been looking to install solar for several years and had done a lot of reading during that time.All I wanted was a straight up quote for a quality system. All costs included - no hidden fees.Leigh and Phil from Central Coast Solar were the only ones to provide this to me.I had one guy from another company tell me I was on 3 phase power and required new power box - which was completely wrong. Im on single phase and power box had oodles of spare room / capacity for not only smart meter install but main house fuse had to be moved into box.These guys supplied a 5KW Sungrow inverter with & upgraded me Q Cell Duo5 panels at no cost.They also installed my inverter under cover in garage and away from direct heat and weather next to power box. It was a difficult cable run and no extra cost.A team of 5 guys arrived and had install completed in about 2.5 hrs.At the end of the day, my system was installed in winter and Im producing 28-29 kw on a good day. Im looking forward to the longer days ahead.

We are very impressed with Phil, Jay,  Leigh and the whole team at Central Coast energy. The whole process of quoting us to wait times and installation was extremely professional and smooth. central coast energy were terrific to deal with. from the initial contact with phil anastas to the installation and after sales service was first class. no query was too much trouble for them to answer.thoroughly recommend this company

The Central Coast Energy team were a pleasure to deal with.  Phil provided great advice and even called around to provide advice onother issues that we were having at our home.  After placing the order, there was nothing else for me to do, which was great.  The installation team were professional and even cleaned up after themselves, which is a rare trait these days, but very pleasing indeed.The overall process, ins/tallation, set to work was great.  We are very glad to have used a local company that we know will have support from should the need arise/Highly recommended

I had selected this company to come out and provide a quote based off the reviews on this site. I was impressed by Phil as he answered all my questions and had already completed an analysis of the system required and the cost before arriving. He also wasn't pushy on the sale and didn't try and up sell.Installers arrived 15 minutes early and had it completed within half a day. Installation quality of the inverter and panels are great.When I was able to turn my inverter on after having my meter box upgraded I noticed an issue with the smart meter not showing analytics on the load and feed in. Without follow up Leigh had then organised for Sungrow to come and look at the issue which was quickly resolved due to a wiring mismatch.Thanks Leigh, Phil and team for an overall positive experience!

I wanted to wait a few months before reviewing to get a good feel for the system but in short, don't hesitate!The entire CC Energy team, from initial quoting, updates to quotes to include different panels and increasing the system size to maximise roof space utilisation through to installation was handled very professionally. Price was very competitive considering the system chosen. Installation was quick, well done and looks great.Would highly recommend them to anyone.
All round great service install was done in one day no hassles

I cant speak highly enough of Phil and Leigh in how they have managed the quoting, specifying and installation process which has all been done remotely since are in lock down and not visiting our beach house.

I have just had 44 panel solar system installed by Central Coast Energy on my rural property. From initial contact through to quotation,installation to commissioning everyone of the staff were courteous,professional and willing to explain every step of the process.I would have no hesitation in recommending Central Coast Energy and have already done so.Now looking forward to much lower electricity bills . Paul
Quote process was easy. Jamie and his partner were very polite and accommodating when installing solar system. nothing was an issue. haven't been connected to grid as yet so cant comment on that

Both Sales Manager and Installer were punctual, polite and very helpful. Customer Service was great in helping organising the grid connection. Would highly recommend Central Coast Energy for Solar system installation.

I thought I would wait  6 months after installation so I could check to see how our new system was performing before reviewing. Bear in mind this took into account a lot cloudy days and smoke filled days. The service from Leigh and his team was great . Installation all done in a day and a short time between accepting the quote and the job being completed. I would thoroughly recommend Central Coast Energy to any prospective buyer.

Leigh and his team made the whole process easy and were a pleasure to deal with. Thoroughly professional, their advice and guidance was invaluable. Installation was completed promptly with a minimum of fuss and disruption.
Excellent communication and punctuality from sales to installer .Everything organised by installer including grid connection .

Highly Recommend Central Coast Energy, Phil help us through the Solar Quote process A1.The Installers were great and kept us up to date with the Installation.And Leigh organised all the paperwork for the energy company, fantastic job done by all would recommend them to anyone.

Thanks to Leigh and his team. From Phil who was very informative and patient explaining in detail in a way that was easy to understand.On installation day Steve and his boys again very professional, informative and tidy. We were happy with all aspects of our dealings with Central Coast Energy. Would have no hesitation in recommending them.
Fantastic service and very easy to deal with. Our solar install was completed quickly and cleanly. Will happily recommend to friends and family.

CC Energy provided optimum service from start to finish. They did the lot and were prompt efficient and professional. Good products and pricing plus at this early stage the results are rewarding.Great company to deal with.

Quote process very straightforward.  Very competitive price, much better than the door to door bunch we began with.  Brilliant on time installation. Could not be happier with our solar system installation by Central Coast Energy. Leigh and his team were friendly and professional from start to finish - turned up on time and left our property spotless after the installation.  Leigh engenders high confidence in the work performed and ongoing service.  Happy to recommend without reservation.

Leigh was recommended to us by a previous customer of his. Leigh's straightforward approach was a breath of fresh air and his quote was very fair when compared with similar sized systems, of which we invited a quote from the previous salesperson with none forthcoming.He organised everything for us and solved a hiccup that resulted from a mutual misunderstanding efficiently and effectively, despite putting his own timeline back a couple of days.Leigh contacted our supplier for a meter upgrade and organised the grid connection for us. We haven't had to worry about a thing. He followed up the installation with details on how to monitor the system online and rang the following day to check on the job. Being new to the world of solar, I am enjoying observing the data I can view, but the real test will be in the next power bill or two, which I am looking forward to analysing, hence the 'not applicable' for quality of system as I don't really know.
Very happy with the Service. Timely, Great Follow Up, Informative
No Fuss install all taken care of by the team at Central Coast Solar

Quick and professional, took care to not damage guttering and replace damaged tiles. Installers were very â€œuser friendlyâ€.Also the included emberpulse dashboard and its cloud based record for my useage and generation is a great tool.

Leigh was very helpful with all the information he provided us. We had a few quotes from other companies but decided to go with Central Coast Energy due to Leigh's honesty and product knowledge. I got 3 quotes through you. The price wasn't the problem but they didn't give me any choice. One said I needed micro-inverters but I have no shading issues and he couldn't really say why they were needed. Another one wasn't interested in my estimation of my daytime usage (calculated using a power point plug-in energy monitor and a wireless monitor (from efergy) for the appliances that were hard wired eg solar pump hot water and air conditioning). All 3 salespeople were quite pushy too and assumed I was stupid. So I googled solar energy installers in my area and found Central Coast Energy. The first thing that sold me was that on their website they offered 3 options from "cheap" to "expensive".
